rationale: Events dated before 2017-01-01 or after 2019-02-01 (e.g. 1948, 2020) are data-entry errors; one impossible date makes the whole case's durations unreliable.
Rows identical in every attribute (same case, activity, minute, user and value) carry no extra timing or routing information but inflate loops and variant counts.
Sort by case, timestamp, then canonical P2P position to break ties between date-only events (23:59/00:00) recorded on the same day.
